title: Add context fields to BulletModel for CGR³ support
description:
Extend BulletModel in src/storage/models.py with context graph fields:

Temporal validity:
- valid_from: datetime (when pattern became valid)
- valid_until: datetime | None (expiration, null = still valid)
- temporal_confidence: float (decays over time)
- tech_context: JSON (e.g., {"python": ">=3.10", "tensorflow": "2.x"})

Locality context:
- team_id: str | None
- project_ids: JSON list
- applicable_domains: JSON list

Enhanced provenance:
- created_by_type: str (human | ai | derived)
- source_conversation_id: str | None
- confidence_score: float

Also add BulletLineageModel for knowledge relationships (derived_from, refined, contradicts, supersedes).

title: Add audit client to TDD agent
description:

- test_generated: When a test is written
- implementation_generated: When code is written  
- pattern_learned: When a bullet is added to playbook

Client must be write-only (no read methods).

title: Add tests for ensemble learner module
Add tests for ensemble voting module
Build playbook enforcement mechanism - block edits without tests
description:
Problem: Agent violated ace-006 (high-frequency feedback) by making 4 edits without running tests. Rules exist in playbook but nothing enforces them.

Solution needed:
1. Before each edit, check session log for untested edits
2. If edits > tests, block or warn
3. Query playbook rules before taking actions
4. Auto-log all edits and test runs

Acceptance criteria:
- Agent cannot batch edits without testing
- Ratio of edits:tests stays close to 1:1
- Violations are logged and visible

title: Implement independent audit service (src/audit/)
description:
Create a separate audit service following the audit trail independence principle:

**Architecture:**
- Same repo, separate deployment
- Agents can write audit events (HTTP POST) but cannot read or modify
- Append-only storage with cryptographic hash chain
- Separate database credentials from main ACE

**Components to create:**
- src/audit/collector.py - Receives events from agents
- src/audit/store.py - Append-only persistence with hash chain
- src/audit/api.py - Read-only query interface for compliance/admin
- src/audit/schemas.py - AuditEvent, AuditQuery types
- src/audit/client.py - Write-only client for agents to emit events

**Key constraints:**
- No UPDATE or DELETE on audit tables
- Agent credentials cannot access audit DB directly
- Hash chain for tamper evidence

**Deploy target:**
- services/ace-audit/ - Separate service configuration

Reference: 202602121757-audit-trail-independence-principle.md

title: Implement CGR³ (Context Graph Retrieve-Rank-Reason) service layer
description:
Create a standalone knowledge retrieval service that any code generation consumer can call:
- Retrieve: Semantic search (existing)
- Rank: Re-rank by context match (team, project, tech stack, temporal validity)
- Reason: Determine verdict (APPLY, ASK_FIRST, SKIP) based on context sufficiency

Key components:
- RetrievalContext dataclass (team_id, project_id, tech_stack, query_timestamp)
- RankedBullet with semantic_score, context_score, context_gaps, verdict
- ContextGraphRetriever class wrapping BulletRetriever
- Scoring functions for temporal, team, tech stack, project context

This is an Enterprise-only feature that adds reasoning on top of existing audit infrastructure.

title: Add tests for playbook manager module
Build MCP server for CGR³ knowledge service
description:
Create MCP server exposing institutional knowledge service to Claude Code/IDE clients.

**Primary tools (CGR³ focused):**
- get_guidance: Query with context-aware reasoning (APPLY/ASK_FIRST/SKIP verdicts)
- learn: Add knowledge to playbook
- query: Simple semantic search
- feedback: Mark patterns helpful/harmful

**Secondary tools:**
- build_feature: TDD cycle (wraps AutonomousTDDAgent)
- get_playbook_info: Playbook status

**Implementation:**
- stdio-based MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0)
- Wraps InstitutionalKnowledgeService
- No database required for query-only mode
- Configuration via args and env vars
